build_MoCo_model: build a MoCo contrastive learning model with query and key encoders for dense retrieval
run_MoCo_forward: run the MoCo forward pass with query and key token inputs to compute contrastive loss
create_MoCo_retriever: create a MoCo retriever by loading a HuggingFace model with optional random initialization
test_MoCo_momentum_update: test the MoCo momentum update mechanism that updates the key encoder from the query encoder
review_MoCo_queue: review the MoCo dequeue and enqueue logic that manages the negative sample queue
